title: Zimbabwe PRAZ Tender Scraper Input
description: Scrape public tender opportunities from Zimbabwe's PRAZ eGP bulletin board with pagination, filters, new-tender detection, opportunity scoring, risk scoring, and optional public PDF requirement extraction.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: The PRAZ eGP bulletin board URL to scrape. Leave the default unless PRAZ changes its public bulletin board route.

maxItems.title: Maximum tenders
maxItems.description: Maximum number of tender records to save.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of bulletin board pages to scrape.

includeDetails.title: Include tender detail pages
includeDetails.description: Visit each tender detail page to extract procurement method, class, bid fees, bid security amounts, document links, requirements, and richer scoring.

keyword.title: Keyword filter
keyword.description: Optional keyword filter. Searches title, reference number, buyer, category, procurement method, location, business category, and extracted requirements.

buyerKeyword.title: Buyer / procuring entity filter
buyerKeyword.description: Filter by buyer or procuring entity, for example ZETDC, POTRAZ, council, ministry.

categoryKeyword.title: Category filter
categoryKeyword.description: Filter by supplier category, for example construction, ICT, medical, vehicles, cleaning.

statusKeyword.title: Status filter
statusKeyword.description: Optional status filter, for example Open.

procurementMethodKeyword.title: Procurement method filter
procurementMethodKeyword.description: Filter by procurement method, for example competitive bidding.

classOfProcurementKeyword.title: Class of procurement filter
classOfProcurementKeyword.description: Filter by class of procurement, for example Works, Goods, Services.

businessCategory.title: Business category filter
businessCategory.description: Filter by generated business category, for example Construction, ICT, Medical, Energy, Security, Cleaning, Vehicles, Consulting.

onlyOpen.title: Only open tenders
onlyOpen.description: If enabled, the Actor only returns tenders with active/open-type statuses.

minimumDaysRemaining.title: Minimum days remaining
minimumDaysRemaining.description: Return only tenders with at least this many days remaining before closing. Use 0 to disable.

maximumDaysRemaining.title: Maximum days remaining
maximumDaysRemaining.description: Return only tenders closing within this number of days. Use 0 to disable.

newOnly.title: New tenders only
newOnly.description: Return only tender records not previously seen in the selected memory store. Status changes are also returned as alerts.

resetSeenTenders.title: Reset seen-tender memory
resetSeenTenders.description: Clear the Actor's seen-tender memory before this run. Useful for testing newOnly mode.

memoryStoreName.title: Memory store name
memoryStoreName.description: Named key-value store used to remember previously seen tender IDs across runs.

extractRequirements.title: Extract requirement signals
extractRequirements.description: Extract eligibility, mandatory, financial, submission, and technical requirement signals from the detail page and optional public PDFs.

analyzeDocuments.title: Analyze public PDF documents
analyzeDocuments.description: Try to download and parse public PDF document links where available. Keep disabled for cheaper/faster runs unless you need PDF requirement extraction.

maxDocumentsPerTender.title: Maximum PDFs per tender
maxDocumentsPerTender.description: Maximum public PDF documents to parse per tender when document analysis is enabled.

maxPdfBytes.title: Maximum PDF size in bytes
maxPdfBytes.description: Skip PDF documents larger than this limit to control costs and runtime.

documentTextMaxChars.title: Maximum extracted PDF text characters
documentTextMaxChars.description: Maximum characters of PDF text to keep per tender for requirement extraction.
